saved_evidence.title: How to obtain a New Mexico tax registration certificate online
saved_evidence.description: The City's step-by-step guide for a business obtaining its New Mexico tax registration certificate through the State Taxpayer Access Point, published for applicants who need the certificate before the City will process their business paperwork.
saved_evidence.evidence: Headed HOW TO Obtain a Registration Certificate Online, and its steps are Log into the Taxpayer Access Point (TAP) at https://tap.state.nm.us, then Request a Current Registration Certificate Letter. TAP is the New Mexico Taxation and Revenue Department's system, so this is the tax registration certificate. The City serves the same 493,169-byte file under a second name; see one_guide_two_names.
